* Unknown assailants fire incendiary devices on an ammunition dump in suburban [[Baghdad]], triggering hours of explosions. American sources put the casualties at six dead and four wounded; [[Iraq]]i sources state 25 wounded. U.S Army 3rd Infantry Division the 11th Engineer Battalion Charlie Co. ASP(Ammo Security Point)89 tons of confiscated munitions exploded after an enemy attack.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A40653-2003Apr26.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120805114859/http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A40653-2003Apr26.html |archive-date=2012-08-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Winnie Mandela]] is sentenced to four years in prison (five years, less one-year suspended) for theft and fraud.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://allafrica.com/stories/200304260034.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120716183245/http://allafrica.com/stories/200304260034.html |archive-date=2012-07-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* Hiker and mountain climber [[Aron Ralston]] is stuck for five days in [[Blue John Canyon]] after an 800-pound rock falls on his right arm, pinning it to the canyon wall.
